_comment: Live stores a caller may name on a real call (demo mode only). Each one is added to the recall's directory when its phone_env is set to an E.164 number in .env on the machine running the API; the number itself never goes in the repo. Unset, the name becomes an ordinary new party with no phone.

stores.name: Ryan's Store
stores.profile: Small independent grocery that buys a few cases from a nearby store when its own order runs short. Not on any shipment record. The owner answers a mobile phone.
